card.name: Linking words before a quinolone drug name
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation such as "including", "such as", "e.g.," and "of" that come right after "quinolones" or "fluoroquinolones" and just before a named drug like ciprofloxacin or moxifloxacin.

modes.label: Class then example drug
modes.description: The link word after a quinolone class name that introduces a specific member such as ciprofloxacin or moxifloxacin.

modes.label: Lists of interacting drugs
modes.description: Punctuation or "and" inside a drug list, just before the next drug name.
